meta.landingTitle: Nablix — Markdown notes with handwriting, runnable code & your own AI
meta.landingDesc: Nablix is a local-first note app for Windows that fuses Markdown, handwritten ink, executable code and BYOK AI. No account, no cloud, no telemetry — your notes stay on your machine.
meta.pricingDesc: Nablix pricing. The free version gives you the editor, handwriting, code execution and AI chat. Monthly, yearly, or pay once.
meta.privacyDesc: How Nablix handles your data: locally. Exactly what leaves your device, when, and why — the complete, short list.
meta.termsDesc: The terms that govern your use of Nablix: license, purchases, refunds, code execution and your responsibilities.

hero.title:
Write. Draw. Run.
All on the same page.
hero.sub: Nablix is a local-first notebook for Windows. Markdown, handwritten ink, runnable code and math — tools that used to live in separate apps, folded into a single page. No account, no cloud.
hero.shotAlt: The actual Nablix interface: a Markdown note with math, handwriting and a runnable code block

features.heading: Stop switching tools.
features.sub: Notes, whiteboard, LaTeX editor, REPL — the focus you lost jumping between them comes back when they share one page.

f1.title: Markdown you edit in place
f1.desc: Slash commands, tables, toggles, columns, a table of contents. However rich the editing, what is saved is a plain .md file you can open anywhere.

f2.title: Handwriting, right on the page
f2.desc: Drop a canvas anywhere in a note and write with your pen — or open a full-page whiteboard. Smooth, pressure-aware ink.

f3.title: Code that actually runs
f3.desc: Run Python, TypeScript and more inside the page and keep the output right below the block. Every page has its own workspace folder, terminal included.

f4.title: Math, and a glossary that grows
f4.desc: KaTeX with custom macros for fast math. Terms you define collect into a glossary automatically and pop up on hover from any page.

f5.title: See how pages relate
f5.desc: A local embedding model measures how close your pages are in meaning and draws them as a constellation. Search is semantic too — and fully offline.

f6.title: Your own AI keys, extended by MCP
f6.desc: Plug in your OpenAI or Anthropic API key for chat and inline completion. A built-in MCP server lets tools like Claude read and write your notes.

dive1.title: Math at the speed of your hand.
dive1.desc: When typing cannot keep up with thinking, just draw. Handwritten formulas are converted to KaTeX and set beautifully on the page.

privacyStrip.title: No account. No cloud. No telemetry.
privacyStrip.desc: Nablix talks to the internet in exactly three cases: your AI calls (your key, your provider), license activation (Lemon Squeezy) and update checks (GitHub). That is the entire list — and the privacy policy is short enough to actually read.

items.a: Early builds are not yet code-signed (a signing certificate is planned before 1.0). Every installer is built automatically from tagged source by GitHub Actions, and you can inspect each release on the releases page. Click 'More info' → 'Run anyway' to proceed.
Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit) today. The codebase is cross-platform and a macOS build is planned once the Windows version is rock solid.
In ordinary folders on your own disk — pages are files you can open, back up, sync or export with any tool you like. Nothing is uploaded to us. There is no 'us' server at all.

items.q: Do I need an AI subscription?
items.a: No. The recommended way to use AI with Nablix is the MCP integration: connect an assistant you already have — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity — and it works with your notes directly. There is also a built-in copilot that takes your own OpenAI or Anthropic API key, but it is far more limited and is no longer the recommended path. Nothing in Nablix depends on AI: every other feature works with no key and no assistant.

Nablix ships a built-in MCP server, so tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Antigravity can read and edit your notes as first-class context. Access is scoped to the page and workspace you currently have open — nothing else is exposed. You can also mark a page as off-limits to AI, by right-clicking it in the sidebar. That page and everything filed under it can then no longer be read or changed by any AI tool, the built-in copilot included.

faq.a: Checkout and billing are handled by Lemon Squeezy, our merchant of record — they process payment, taxes and invoices. You receive a license key by email within minutes; paste it into Nablix (Settings → License) and you are done.

faq.q: Can I use one license on multiple devices?
faq.a: Yes. Your license can be deactivated on one device and activated on another at any time, right from the app. It is licensed per person, not per machine.
A one-time payment that unlocks every Pro feature permanently, including future updates of the app. It is not a subscription and there is nothing to renew.

faq.q: What happens if I cancel Pro?
faq.a: Your notes are never held hostage. Everything remains viewable, editable and exportable. If you are over the Free limits you simply cannot create new pages or folders until you are back under them — or until you upgrade again.
Lemon Squeezy calculates and adds any applicable VAT or sales tax at checkout based on your country, and handles all tax paperwork as merchant of record.

Your purchase is made from Lemon Squeezy, which acts as Merchant of Record. Refunds are therefore handled by Lemon Squeezy under its own refund policy, so send refund requests to them rather than to us. Statutory consumer rights in your jurisdiction are unaffected.

faq.q: Is there a Microsoft Store version?
faq.a: A Store edition is planned. Store sandbox rules disallow launching external processes, so code execution is exclusive to the official edition you download here. Licenses purchased on this site activate the official edition.

faq.q: Do I need to pay extra for AI?
faq.a: Nablix never charges for AI. You bring your own OpenAI or Anthropic API key and pay your provider directly for usage — typically pennies for note-taking workloads. AI chat is unlimited on every plan, including Free.
